heard: For a full century, the heaviest invertebrate on Earth was a ghost. Known mostly from damaged dead specimens and whale scars, the colossal squid had never been seen swimming alive anywhere. That incredible dark mystery changed completely on March 9, 2025, near the remote South Sandwich Islands. An international research team using the advanced remotely operated vehicle, Sue Bastian, recorded the historic moment. The camera surprisingly revealed a translucent juvenile measuring about 12 inches long. It drifted quietly in the dark blue at a depth of 600 meters. After a full century hidden away as a ghost, the heaviest invertebrate on Earth finally came into focus.
differences: 'subastian' heard as 'sue bastian' after 'remotely operated vehicle'
